response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The camera pans over the rolling hills and lush forests of the medieval kingdom, but something is off. The once-majestic stone walls now seem dull and grey, the flags bearing the royal crest now fluttering in a strange, discordant rhythm.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King ARIN, a stout and proud man in his late 40s, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. But as he gazes out the window, his expression changes from regal to bewildered.

KING ARIN
(to his advisor, LORD THORNE)
What sorcery is this? The colors of our banners, once so bold and vibrant, now seem... faded.

LORD THORNE
Your Majesty, it is but the natural wear of time. The sun beats down upon our flags, causing them to fade.

KING ARIN
(skeptical)
I have ordered the royal heralds to re-dye the banners, but they return with a strange, synthetic material that seems to shift and writhe in the light.

CUT TO:

INT. ROYAL WORKSHOP - DAY

The royal heralds, led by the hapless SERGEANT PATEL, toil over a workbench, attempting to create a new banner. They mix and match strange, glowing dyes, adding a dash of this and a pinch of that.

SERGEANT PATEL
(excitedly)
We've added a hint of neon pink, a dash of electric blue, and a sprinkle of glittering silver!

KING ARIN
(approvingly)
Ah, yes. This is more like it.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The new banner is unfurled, and the kingdom's aesthetic begins to shift. The once-majestic stone walls now seem to ripple and undulate, like the surface of a stagnant pond. The flags, once proud and bold, now flutter in a strange, hypnotic rhythm.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Arin, now fully embracing the proto-vaporwave aesthetic, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. He gazes out the window, a look of wonder on his face.

KING ARIN
(to his advisor, LORD THORNE)
I have decreed that our kingdom shall henceforth be known as... "Neonopia".

LORD THORNE
(stunned)
But, Your Majesty, what of our traditional values and customs?

KING ARIN
(waving his hand dismissively)
Pfft, those are so... last season. We shall forge a new path, one of... (he searches for the right word)...glitchy, distorted grandeur.

CUT TO:

EXT. NEONOPIA - DAY

The kingdom of Neonopia stretches out before us, a surreal landscape of rippling stone walls, fluttering flags, and strange, glowing dyes. The camera pans up, revealing a sky that seems to be made of a thousand tiny, shimmering pixels.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
